notes.title: 1.0.4 Patch
notes.content:
[h1]v1.0.4 Patch Notes[/h1]

[h2]Game Direction Changes[/h2]
[h3]Before Patch[/h3]
A one-time random defense game, heavily dependent on luck with card selection.

[h3]After Patch[/h3]
A game with enhanced RPG elements where units grow with experience points and skills are enhanced with skill points.

[h2]Removed Features[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Removed Unit Draw[/b]: Units now grow through experience points, and the draw system has been removed.
[*][b]Removed Stat Cards from Card Draw System[/b]: Stat cards have been removed in favor of growth through experience points.
[*][b]Removed Gem Currency[/b]: The gem currency has been removed from the game.
[/list]

[h2]Added Features[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Zoom Function[/b]: A feature to zoom in and out of the game screen has been added.
[*][b]Tutorial Added[/b]: Basic gameplay instructions for new players have been added.
[*][b]New Enemy Units Added[/b]:
[list]
[*][u]Belt Egg [/u]: Has a lot of health.
[*][u]Crown Egg [/u]: Generates a shield that blocks projectiles for 3 seconds when attacked.
Boss trait: Shield always active.
[*][u]Leaf Egg [/u]: Has a chance to evade attacks (25% evasion chance).
Boss trait: 50% evasion chance.
[*][u]Spike Egg [/u]: Creates a short-range nova when attacking, reducing the mana of units hit by the nova by 20.
Boss trait: Mana reduction doubled (40 mana reduction).
[*][u]Winged Egg [/u]: Movement speed increases by 50% when damaged, lasting for 5 seconds.
Boss trait: Always active.
[*][u]Phoenix Egg [/u]: Recovers to 100% health when health falls below 30%.
Boss trait: Revives twice.
[*][u]Horned Egg [/u]: Recovers 10% of max health each time it is attacked.
Boss trait: Recovers 5% of max health each time it is attacked.
[*][u]Helmet Egg [/u]: Takes 1 damage from all attacks.
[/list]
[b]Runes Added[/b]:
[list]
[*]Rune that reduces upgrade consumption time
[*]Rune that reduces upgrade consumption cost
[*]Rune that increases damage to bosses
[/list]
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where rune synthesis did not function correctly.
[/list]
